issue.title: test_production_machine_query_oracle_repairs_owner_after_index fails under the parallel scoped lane, passes in isolation
issue.description: During the mandatory `just check` gate for a rebase-conflict repair (sase-core-revision.txt pin ratchet + one assertion tweak in tests/monitor/test_monitor_resume.py — neither touches agent load tiering), the scoped parallel test lane failed exactly this node and nothing else: `1 failed, 41425 passed, 15 skipped in 913.78s` under `pytest -n 7 --dist=worksteal`. The exact node then passed immediately on the unchanged tree in isolation (0.51s call), passed 3/3 further serial reruns, and its whole file passed 13/13 serially. Fail rate so far: 1 parallel-lane failure, 0/5 serial reproductions; does not reproduce serially. Failure traceback was not captured (gate output was tail-truncated). The fails-under-parallel-lane/passes-in-isolation shape matches the process-global-state-leak class of epic sase-j7 and retired umbrella sase-ct (narrow node-specific records only).

task_type_fields.evidence: 2026-09-13, workspace sase_13, rebase of fcb40d83ff onto 8f7dad695b (tree: master 8f7dad695b + core pin ratchet to b598337 + one splitlines assertion in tests/monitor/test_monitor_resume.py). FAIL: once under `just test-scoped`'s `pytest -n 7 --dist=worksteal` lane (sole failure among 41,425 passes). PASS: immediately after on the same tree — 1x isolated (-x), 3x serial node reruns, 1x whole-file serial (13 passed). Serial repro: none (0/5). Traceback not captured; gate output was piped through tail -60.
